summary: Fixes a real r0044 gap: the interactive recovery workflow broadcast identical args to every stage, unable to express the offline-E8 contract's stage-specific frozen-media inputs (Stage 10 apt/snap closure, Stage 20 Git mirror, Stage 60/80 pip wheelhouse, Stage 80 companion mirrors). Adds one recovery-media root concept (interactive discovery, or --recovery-media-root) with per-stage argument/env routing in restore.sh. Does not change the r0043/r0044 ledger/adoption design.
